analysis_status: designed after the clean week-level opportunity result was observed; robustness only, not confirmatory
question: Does the focal-response-excluded opportunity signal persist when plant flowering and pollinator activity must occur in the same site and ISO week rather than merely the same week anywhere in the study area?

surface.plant_availability: number of site-week cells in the target year where the focal plant has no.fl.obs > 0
surface.pollinator_activity: number of site-week cells in the target year where the focal pollinator has a positive visit to any plant other than the focal plant
surface.pairwise_overlap: number of site-week cells shared by those two focal-response-excluded sets

model.family: separate binomial logistic models for gain and loss
model.cross_validation: same leave-one-transition-out strict-core, near-core and all-annual scopes as the repaired week-level baseline

success_read: positive held-out proper-score skill in each primary transition for both endpoints would show that the repaired current-state opportunity signal is not created solely by pooling spatially separated records within the same week

interpretation.allowed: spatiotemporally stricter focal-response-excluded opportunity retains held-out association with annual link dynamics

claim_ceiling: Post-result spatiotemporal robustness only. Persistence under same-site same-week matching strengthens the current-state opportunity interpretation but does not establish causality, effort independence, strict forecasting, decision equivalence, or routeability.
